scenes.line1: Can you sum up your story?
scenes.say: Can you sum up your story in just sixty seconds? Let’s make your answer shine.

scenes.label: Present
scenes.sub: State your current role and years of experience.
scenes.say: Start with your current role and how many years you’ve been doing it.

rows.b: Keep it to one line each

scenes.say: Next, share two things you own today, each with a number. Be concise—one line each.

scenes.label: Past
scenes.sub: One sentence on a previous role or experience.
scenes.say: Now, give a single sentence about a past role or experience.

scenes.title: What’s next?
lines: $ Tie your goal to this job
scenes.say: Finish with what you want next, and link it to this job. Rewrite for each posting and practice until it’s a smooth sixty seconds.

scenes.question: What’s a common intro mistake?
scenes.right: Rambling, or missing metrics and goals
scenes.say: A common trap is rambling or missing numbers and goals. Don’t just list your whole resume.
